Chapter 1 of Software Engineering, titled "Software Engineering Process," covers several key topics over approximately 6 planned hours. These topics include professional software development, software engineering ethics, case studies, software processes (including various software process models), process activities, and strategies for coping with change. The learning outcomes for this chapter aim to enable students to explain the role of software engineering in development, identify ethical and professional issues, and select appropriate process models for software systems.
